page_title: MON 1-2 UDI | Monza v Udinese 09/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Milan Djuric (Monza) makes a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
90+6' James Abankwah (Udinese) produces a stunning solo run from the middle of the pitch, all the way to the penalty area. He unleashes a decent strike which goes narrowly wide of the right post.
90+4' Surely that's handball by one of the Udinese players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+3' The game has come to an end for Jurgen Ekkelenkamp. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of James Abankwah (Udinese).
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Iker Bravo (Udinese) was quite harsh and Gianluca Manganiello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Here's the change. Sandi Lovric leaves the pitch and Arthur Atta (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.
89' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
89' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
89' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
87' Stefano Sensi (Monza) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
87' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Udinese is cautioned for aggressive play.
86' Stefano Sensi (Monza) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mirko Maric (Monza) comes onto the pitch so that Daniel Maldini can be given a rest.
79' Alessandro Nesta prepares a substitution. Alessandro Bianco is replaced by Stefano Sensi (Monza).
79' The substitution is prepared. Omari Forson (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gianluca Caprari.

79' Crossbar! Dany Mota (Monza) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
78' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
77' Rough tackle by Pablo Mari (Monza). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Substitution. Iker Bravo (Udinese) on for Florian Thauvin.
76' A player from Monza commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
73' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Handball by Alessandro Bianco (Monza).
71' Alessandro Nesta decides to make a substitution. Andrea Carboni will be replaced by Samuele Birindelli (Monza).
71' Substitution. Pedro Pereira leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dany Mota (Monza).
70' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
70' 1 - 2 Goal! Jaka Bijol (Udinese) slotted the ball past the goalkeeper!
70' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.
68' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
67' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Kingsley Ehizibue. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post.
66' Gianluca Manganiello couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jaka Bijol (Udinese) and blew his whistle.
65' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle. Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) commits a foul after dangerous play.
63' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gianluca Manganiello had an easy-decision to make.
60' The referee blows his whistle as Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) was too aggressive in his challenge.
57' 24:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
57' High and wide! Daniel Maldini (Monza) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
57' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and makes a call.

55' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the left side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Stefano Turati.
55' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
54' The corner kick from Gianluca Caprari (Monza) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
54' Milan Djuric (Monza) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Razvan Sava produces a wonderful reflex save.
52' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
52' Pedro Pereira (Monza) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:1.
46' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) replaces Oier Zarraga.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Gianluca Manganiello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Daniel Maldini (Monza) who directs his shot to the top left corner, but the keeper is there in time to stop his effort.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and it's Gianluca Caprari (Monza) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
43' Warren Bondo (Monza) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
42' Corner kicks – 7:0.
42' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
41' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
41' Daniel Maldini (Monza) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
40' Warren Bondo (Monza) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
39' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is adjudged offside.
39' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
38' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends the corner into the box, but Razvan Sava intercepts it and averts the threat.
38' Gianluca Caprari slides a brilliant pass into Pedro Pereira (Monza), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
38' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
37' A player from Udinese commits a rough challenge. Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
37' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
35' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
34' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

32' Pedro Pereira (Monza) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gianluca Manganiello with no other option than to blow for a foul.
32' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
31' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
31' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Stefano Turati, who smothers the ball.
30' Pedro Pereira (Monza) was too forceful with his tackle and Gianluca Manganiello interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
28' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Gianluca Manganiello no option but to blow his whistle.
26' Udinese concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
26' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
25' Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
24' Milan Djuric (Monza) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Razvan Sava is prepared and dives to thwart him.
23' Milan Djuric (Monza) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.
22' Warren Bondo (Monza) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
21' A player from Udinese commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
20' The free kick from long range, taken by Monza, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
16' One of the Udinese players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
16' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) tries his luck with a promising long-range shot from a rebound, but the ball sails painfully wide of the right post. What a great effort!
15' The resulting corner from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is cleared by the defence.
15' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
12' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
12' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
11' Andrea Carboni (Monza) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
8' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

6' 0 - 1 Goal! Jordan Zemura clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), who gets on the end of it and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the right side of the goal. Stefano Turati had no chance of stopping that. 0:1.
5' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but Razvan Sava comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' Pedro Pereira (Monza) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monza, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' One of the Udinese players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
2' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
